Title: 2027 Plantable Seed Paper Calendar with Wooden Stand | Vintage Floral Wall Art
Description (HTML):
Bloom Again is a 2027 plantable seed paper calendar featuring twelve beautiful garden flowers and collectible vintage botanical artwork. More than a calendar, each finished monthly page offers a chance to grow something new, bringing sustainability and everyday beauty together.

Inspired by 1950s botanical lithographs, Bloom Again celebrates recognizable flowers through rich garden colors, charming vintage-inspired illustrations, and timeless floral compositions. Designed for eco-conscious women, gardening enthusiasts, flower lovers, and sustainable-living shoppers, it makes a thoughtful Mother's Day, birthday, housewarming, or holiday gift. The wooden stand adds a natural touch to its botanical presentation, while the plantable pages make every month part of a greener year.

What's inside

  • January to March: Winter Awakening, Fragrant Beginnings, and Golden Springlight.
  • April to June: Blue for Tomorrow, A Mother's Bloom, and Fragrance in Bloom.
  • July to September: Follow the Sun, Summer Color Party, and Dancing Through Autumn.
  • October to December: Golden Garden Glow, Autumn's Lasting Beauty, and Winter Blooms Again.

Details

  • Sizes:
    • 11 x 8.5 in (opens to 11 x 17 in)
    • 14 x 11.5 in (opens to 14 x 23 in)
  • Finish: Matte or Glossy
  • Binding: wire-bound, with a hanging hole
  • Printing: printed on demand and shipped to you
